verdict.rationale: Claude Code offers an Agent SDK with 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions,' a scriptable CLI built on Unix philosophy (pipeable, CI-friendly), and the ability to run itself as an MCP server — all suggesting strong programmatic parity with interactive use. However, there's no explicit documentation claiming full feature parity between the terminal/IDE UI and API/SDK, and some community reports point to hidden internal behaviors (decoy tool injection, undercover mode) that suggest the API surface may not be fully transparent or equivalent to what the UI does.
